localEquivalentCheck.evidence: open-sse/handlers/imageProviders/index.js IMAGE_ADAPTERS has no `ideogram` or `ideo` key; open-sse/providers/registry/ideogram.js declares serviceKinds [], hiddenKinds ["image"] and imageConfig { baseUrl: "https://api.ideogram.ai", authHeader: "Api-Key" } with the comment 'Hidden until an image adapter is registered'. The fal-ai (fal-ai/ideogram/v2), huggingface (ideogram-ai/ideogram-4-fp8), together (ideogram/ideogram-3.0) and kie (ideogram/v3-*) rows are other vendors' hosted Ideogram models on their own endpoints and auth, not api.ideogram.ai/generate with Api-Key.

exports.ideogramImageAdapter: default image adapter instance (guarded generate adapter)
exports.createIdeogramImageAdapter: factory; options { callTimeoutMs, totalTimeoutMs, imageFetcher, now } for tests
exports.buildIdeogramImageRequest: (model, body) -> { request: { prompt, aspect_ratio, model }, count }; throws status 400
exports.ideogramAcceptedJob: (modality, jobState, meta) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.ideogramPublicUrl: public https URL check used for results
exports.IDEOGRAM_ORIGIN: the only origin the key is sent to
exports.IDEOGRAM_DEFAULT_MODEL: "V_3" (source default when no model is given)

models.publicIds: ideogram/V_3, ideogram/V_2A (and ideo/<id> through the registry alias)
models.dynamicDiscovery: none in the source; static two-model list only

endpoints.resultDownload: data[0].url, public https only, via open-sse/translator/concerns/image.js fetchImageAsBase64 (pinned public IP, manual redirect, 10 MB cap, magic-byte check)
